% Source rule typography.  Premises and conclusion are set in display style
% and the rule name upright at \small size in parentheses, the metrics of
% \hbrule, whatever mix of text and math the name contains; an empty name
% adds nothing.  A side condition is set at \footnotesize, the \hbrule
% side-condition size, on one line when it fits .42\linewidth and otherwise
% in a ragged-right box of that width centred on the rule, so multi-premise
% displays stay within the measure.  Premises, conclusion, name, discharge
% marks and side text are passed through unchanged.
\newsavebox\hb@sidebox
\newcommand\hb@sourcerule[3]{%
  \dfrac{#2}{#3}%
  \if\relax\detokenize{#1}\relax\else\;\text{\normalfont\small(#1)}\fi}
\newcommand\hb@sourceside[1]{%
  \quad
  \sbox\hb@sidebox{\normalfont\footnotesize #1}%
  \ifdim\wd\hb@sidebox>.42\linewidth
    \parbox[c]{.42\linewidth}{\normalfont\footnotesize\raggedright #1}%
  \else
    \usebox\hb@sidebox
  \fi}
